claim: Initial guidance scales are selected by complete-population condition-aligned evaluation of two backgrounds and eight independent early-window neighbours of one fixed reference.
generation_route: Explicitly requested Suixiang image API; gpt-image-2.6-sunburst
layout: Wide four-panel workflow: molecular condition, two backgrounds, fixed-reference neighbours, initial schedule selection.
visual_policy: White background, Arial-like sans-serif, restrained teal and amber, graphite chemistry, no shadows or decorative cards.
example: 6PYY / H7S, 17 heavy atoms, 9 condition atoms; original structure and frozen condition coordinates must agree.
data_integrity: Use measured calibration values only. Molecular reference geometry and connectivity are authoritative. AI-generated schematic elements are illustrations rather than new structural evidence.
exports: Original API PNG, source molecular reference images and coordinates, prompt and credential-free request metadata. Raster generation does not create editable vector labels.
publication_target: Double-column scientific-method schematic; final journal acceptance and editable-label preparation require separate checks.
